concept: ELB: ALB path-based routing to different target groups
tests: Knowing the Layer 7 feature that routes requests by URL path.
expected: ALB with path-based routing listener rules (/api, /images → different target groups). Triggers: "by URL path", "different target groups", "single application".
why_not: NLB is Layer 4 and cannot see the URL; GWLB is for appliances (GENEVE); Route 53 weighted splits DNS traffic by percentage, not by path.
